components.note: CMake torch extension. On ROCm it holds no HIP code: TK (sm_90a), Blackwell PTX VSA and NCCL-device Ulysses are CUDA-arch-gated off, and the CUTLASS turbodiffusion .cu files are CUDA-language sources a HIP-only configure does not compile. Porter verifies what `build.sh --rocm` produces with hip-lang present (plan.md R1) and makes the ROCm build either build nothing or build something that imports. Turbodiffusion int8 GEMM/norm/quant: no fastvideo caller, CUTLASS has no HIP target -- proposed out, pending jeff (plan.md Q2)
attn_qat_infer Blackwell FP4 (sm_120a/121a, CUTLASS/CuTe); CMake already disables it on ROCm -- proposed out, pending jeff (plan.md Q2)
attn_qat_infer FP4 quantization (sm_120a/121a, CUTLASS); CMake already disables it on ROCm -- proposed out, pending jeff (plan.md Q2)
The ROCm deliverable of the kernel package: VSA (64-token) and VSA-256/H3 block-sparse attention fwd+bwd in Triton, vsa_utils, tile layout, fused_compress_topk, vmoba. Validated on every gate.
Upstream PR #669 platform: detection (amdsmi, or HIP torch + /dev/kfd), SDPA / FlashAttention selection with SDPA fallback, device communicator. Validated on every gate.
Upstream PR #1851 routing of VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN and VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 to Triton on ROCm. Validated end to end (plan.md test plan T3).
